acceptanceCriteria: Contract exposes and validates the reference-parity fields required for intent, scenario coverage, acceptance dimensions, parallel-slot declarations, and preflight review without silently accepting malformed or contradictory declarations.
Preflight review presents unresolved human decisions and required next actions, and not_ready or needs_human_confirmation remains fail-closed for implementation.
Existing Rust lifecycle, repository isolation, outcome, and evidence semantics remain compatible; no generated governance record is hand-edited.
Tri-language documentation explains the supported Rust mapping, deliberate differences, and the boundary between facts and human governance decisions.
Focused tests cover valid, missing, malformed, contradictory, stale, and scope-conflicting Contract inputs, including parallel-slot safety.
goal: Introduce strict Rust Contract validation for reference-parity fields and fail-closed preflight review.
intent: Make the first Contract-parity batch fail closed and human-readable while preserving repository isolation and Rust protocol boundaries.
